Answer.description:
An answer, as the person who gives it gives it.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the digest isn't a SHA-256.

arguments_digest.description: The digest of the arguments the person was shown; an answer to others is refused.
arguments_digest.title: Arguments Digest

reason.description: Why, in the person's words, if they gave one.
reason.title: Reason

scope.description: How far it stands beyond its call, from the scopes the request offered, if at all.

surface.description: The surface it was given on, such as ``portalr``, :data:`CONFIRM_SURFACE` or ``mcp``.
surface.title: Surface

Answer.title: Answer

AnswerScope.description:
How far an answer stands beyond its own call: for a run or a session, for what patterns.

Raises:
    ValueError: If it names no pattern.

expires_at.description: When it stops standing, if before the session or run ends.
expires_at.title: Expires At

patterns.description: What it allows, from those the request offered, such as a command's prefix.
patterns.title: Patterns

within.description: How long it stands: the code session's life or the run's.
within.title: Within

AnswerScope.title: AnswerScope

Answered.description: An answer as the store records it: who gave it, and when.

arguments_digest.description: The digest of the arguments the person was shown; an answer to others is refused.
arguments_digest.title: Arguments Digest

reason.description: Why, in the person's words, if they gave one.
reason.title: Reason

scope.description: How far it stands beyond its call, from the scopes the request offered, if at all.

surface.description: The surface it was given on, such as ``portalr``, :data:`CONFIRM_SURFACE` or ``mcp``.
surface.title: Surface

Answered.title: Answered

Answerers.description:
Who may answer an approval.

Anyone who holds ``action`` may answer, or is named in ``subjects``, or is in one of
``groups``. A person delegates by a grantr grant of the action, with an expiry, not by a
field here. A service principal answers only where it is named or holds the action itself,
and never a ``confirmation``.

Raises:
    ValueError: If it names no one, ``action`` isn't a grantr action, or a confirmation
        isn't one subject's alone.

action.description: The grantr action whose holders may answer, such as ``grantr:answer_approval``.
action.title: Action

confirmation.description:
Whether it is the caller's own confirmation of an ``admin_high`` call: answered only by
the one subject named, on :data:`CONFIRM_SURFACE`, never by the client that called, by
elicitation or by a push action.
confirmation.title: Confirmation

different_approver.description: Whether the answer must come from someone other than the person who asked.
different_approver.title: Different Approver

groups.description: The ids of the groups whose members may answer.
groups.title: Groups

subjects.description: The ids of the subjects who may answer.
subjects.title: Subjects

Answerers.title: Answerers

Approval.description:
An approval, asked: its request, where it stands, and its answer or why it closed.

Raises:
    ValueError: If its answer or reason doesn't fit its state: an answer exactly when it is
        approved or denied, agreeing with it, and a reason exactly when it expired or was
        withdrawn; or it was taken without being approved.

answer.description: The answer that settled it, if one did.

arguments_digest.description: The digest of the call's arguments (:func:`arguments_digest`), which an answer binds to.
arguments_digest.title: Arguments Digest

asked_by.description: Who called: a person, or an agent's run or a code session and the person it acts for.

capability.description: The name of the capability called.
capability.title: Capability

covers.description: The listed actions a plan's approval pre-approves; empty for any other.
covers.title: Covers

reason.description: Why it expired or was withdrawn.
reason.title: Reason

rendering.description: Exactly what the call would do.

scope.description: The tenant's workspace the call is made in.

scopes_offered.description:
The patterns an answer's scope may name; empty, so no answer may carry a scope, unless
the capability offers some.
scopes_offered.title: Scopes Offered

taken_at.description: When the one call it lets through went ahead, if one has: an approval is for one call.
taken_at.title: Taken At

version.description: The version of the capability called.
version.title: Version

via.description:
The outside client the call came through, or None for lattice's own surfaces. A
different approver is never offered it there.

Approval.title: Approval

ListedAction.description:
An action a run's plan lists, which the plan's approval pre-approves.

``digest`` covers the step, the capability's whole definition, the target and the calls
allowed, so a capability that changes (another major, tier or effects) is no longer covered.
Build one with :meth:`of`, which computes it.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the capability's name isn't of :data:`~lattice_core.capabilities.NAME`'s
        form, or the digest isn't a SHA-256.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the step, the capability's definition, the target and ``max_calls``.
digest.title: Digest

max_calls.description: How many calls a run may make under it, or None for no limit beyond the run's.
max_calls.title: Max Calls

step.description: The id of the plan's step that calls it.
step.title: Step

target.description:
The condition the call's arguments must meet, as its JSON (lattice RFC-0012), or None
for any arguments.

ListedAction.title: ListedAction

PersonCaller.description: A person calling for themselves, by their identity provider's id.
PersonCaller.title: PersonCaller

Rendering.description:
Exactly what a call would do, as a person is shown it before they answer.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the title is empty, or neither a diff nor the arguments are given.

arguments.description: The call's arguments, where no diff shows what it does.

diff.description: The change it would make, as a unified diff, where it changes text.
diff.title: Diff

summary.description: More of what it does, where a line isn't enough.
summary.title: Summary

title.description: What is asked, in a line: "Send the weekly report to finance@".
title.title: Title

Rendering.title: Rendering

RunCaller.description: An agent's run, or a stored workflow's, calling as part of its work.

agent.description: The agent or stored workflow the run runs, whose tier ceiling applies.
agent.title: Agent

on_behalf_of.description: The id of the person the run acts for, if it acts for one.
on_behalf_of.title: On Behalf Of

RunCaller.title: RunCaller

Scope.description: Where capabilities are offered and called: a tenant's workspace.
Scope.title: Scope

SessionCaller.description: A code session calling as part of its work.

on_behalf_of.description: The id of the person the session acts for, if it acts for one.
on_behalf_of.title: On Behalf Of

SessionCaller.title: SessionCaller

Subject.description: Someone who answers: a person, or a service principal, by their grantr id.

groups.description: The ids of the groups it is a member of.
groups.title: Groups

service.description: Whether it is a service principal rather than a person.
service.title: Service

Subject.title: Subject

Via.description:
The outside client a call came through (lattice RFC-0014).

A provider builds its actor from it, the client acting for the caller, so grants are the
caller's own and audit names the client.

client_name.description: The client's name, as audit shows it: "Alex via Claude".
client_name.title: Client Name

connection_id.description: The id of the connection the client called through.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

surface.description: The protocol the client called through.
surface.title: Surface

Via.title: Via

description: lattice's approval contract: `approval` is one call asked of the people who may answer it, with its request, its state and its answer, and `answer` what one of them gives.
